required_checks_source: files/policies/checks.json checks[required_in_ci == true] (single source; generated file files/policies/ci-required.json)

branch_roles.note: Descriptive only. The live keys are top-level promotion_branch (promotion PR base) and base_branch (integration/default head); the gh pr create reads promotion_branch directly.
branch_roles.task: task/<task_id> per-task branches are historical; no live tool reads a task prefix, so promotion_branch_prefix (task/) was removed in A51. git push allowlists spec-comp, lane/a, lane/b only.
branch_roles.base_branch: spec-comp: integration branch; default head of the promotion PR and the branch lanes reconcile into.
branch_roles.promotion_branch: feat/add-frontend: base of the promotion PR; never a head.

product_side_pending.note: Factory-side readiness for the two checks that belong in product CI. The factory already defines RADON and BANDIT as high/max checks with exact commands in ci-required.json github_check_map; they are not yet required_in_ci because the product workflow does not produce them. The owner/FDE must add the two jobs below to backend-tests.yml (or a new workflow), change the two github_check_map entries from factory-gate to product-ci with the observed job names, set required_in_ci=true for RADON and BANDIT in checks.json, regenerate ci-required/branch-protection with scripts/generate_policies.py, and re-run the gh api branch protection apply path. Until then the factory refuses an unmapped required id rather than claiming a GitHub check that does not exist.

jobs.failure_rule: rank C or worse on a changed non-test Python file
MEDIUM or higher on a changed non-test Python file

merge_method_note: FF-only lane sync; section promotion uses a merge commit at the pinned head. Never squash/rebase, and never change the strategy because a dormant deployment check is red.

deployment.rule: A deploy workflow that is red while DEPLOY_ENABLED is not true is environmental and never a CHECKS_FAILED or a merge blocker. If DEPLOY_ENABLED is true, the deployment is a release attempt: its red check is CI_FAILED and must be repaired, never merged around. Deployment never changes the merge method.
